Susan Electricals India Limited IPO Details

About Company

Susan Electricals India Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of aluminium and copper-based electrical products. Their product portfolio includes winding wires, conductors and power cables. The products are used in transformers, motors, power distribution and transmission. Customers include DISCOMs, EPC contractors and infrastructure companies. The company also trades aluminium wires/rods and provides job-work services.
